meta.title: KŌBŌ Keys — mechanical keyboard workshop
meta.description: Mechanical keyboards, keycaps and switches with a Japanese soul. Build your own keyboard online.

hero.imageAlt: A mechanical keyboard exploded into layers among cherry blossom petals
hero.text: Hand-assembled, every switch lubed, every sound checked. Pick a ready-made board or build your own — from the case to the engraving on the spacebar.

bento.lead: Four moods — from morning tea to Tokyo at night. Tap a tile to see everything in that colour.

neon.text: Clear cases and RGB for night sessions.

builder.title: Build the keyboard of your dreams
builder.text: Choose a layout, case, keycaps, switches and lighting — the preview and price update instantly. Share your build with a link.
builder.previewAlt: A keyboard preview from the builder with RGB lighting

workshop.imageAlt: The workshop bench: tools, switches and a desk lamp
workshop.title: Every keyboard passes through a builder's hands
workshop.text: We don't ship boxes from a warehouse. Every keyboard is assembled, its stabilisers lubed, every key tested — and only then packed.

1.text: It sounds so good I type just for the sound. The unboxing is a treat on its own.
1.author: Kasia, Warsaw

2.text: Built it in the configurator and a week later I held exactly what I had seen on screen.
2.author: Ren, Berlin

3.text: My third keyboard from here. Light through a clear case is pure magic.
3.author: Mateusz, Kraków

4.text: The wooden case smells of cypress. I never thought a keyboard could feel cosy.
4.author: Anna, Gdańsk
